title: City Budget Unveiled: Video Presentation
summary:
*   A special meeting convened to focus on the forthcoming 1986-87 operating budget for the city.
*   City Manager Jorge Carrasco formally presented the proposed budget, utilizing both a video presentation and a verbal overview.
*   Council members engaged in a discussion regarding the city's financial plans for the upcoming year.
